participant_id.Description: Unique identifier of the participant, matching participants.tsv

dry_eyes.Description: Subjective feeling of dryness in the eyes

eye_pain.Description: Subjective feeling of pain or soreness in the eyes

blurred_vision.Description: Subjective report of blurred or unfocused vision

photophobia.Description: Subjective sensitivity or aversion to light during the task

headache.Description: Subjective feeling of headache or tension around the head

visual_afterimages.Description: Perception of residual visual afterimages after the flickering blocks stop
